pages.text: The Akaishi Pulverizer is the first machine of the ore-processing line. Each operation takes 100 ticks at 15 energy/tick with a 100k internal buffer; deepslate ores yield the same result as their normal variants.$(br2)$(bold)Akaishi line (two steps):$(reset)$(li)Akaishi Ore (4 tiers × 4 environments) → 1 Compressed Akaishi Essence$(li)Compressed Akaishi Essence → ×2 Akaishi Dust$(br2)$(bold)Other ores (one step):$(reset)$(li)Coal, Iron, Gold, Diamond, Emerald or Quartz ore → ×2 matching dust$(li)Copper ore → ×3 Copper Dust$(li)Lapis ore → ×4 Lapis Dust$(li)Redstone ore → ×4 vanilla Redstone$(li)Ancient Debris → 1 Netherite Dust$(li)Obsidian → 1 Obsidian Dust

Dust is the intermediate product of the machine line: it is pressed back into blocks by the Compressor or converted into bases by the Transformer.$(br2)$(bold)Two notes:$(reset)$(li)Obsidian Dust and Netherite Dust have no vanilla smelting recipe; recovering Obsidian or Netherite Ingots requires pulverizing and then compressing$(li)Lapis, copper and redstone yield the most dust (3-4 per ore) and should be processed first$(br2)Connecting item pipes to feed ores in and extract dust provides an automated ore-processing line.

After pulverizing, press blocks with the $(l:akaishi:compressor)Compressor$(/l), produce bases with the $(l:akaishi:transformer)Transformer$(/l), or consult the $(l:akaishi:dusts)Dusts$(/l) list. Ore sources are covered in $(l:akaishi:ore)Akaishi Ore Clusters$(/l).
